agents.name: Contoso Expense Review Agent
agents.description: Reviews expense submissions and supporting documents for policy exceptions.
agents.title: AI agent accessed an unexpected expense document
agents.summary: A dormant expense-review agent is represented in a manual proxy story involving unexpected document access.
agents.recommendedActions: Review the agent identity, declared delegated permissions, sponsor, and document scope.

agents.name: Contoso HR Onboarding Agent
agents.description: Coordinates onboarding checklists and employee welcome materials.
agents.title: AI agent attempted broad onboarding data collection
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models an onboarding agent collecting more user and mailbox context than expected.
agents.recommendedActions: Validate delegated consent, narrow the data boundary, and review the agent sponsor.

agents.name: Contoso Finance Forecast Agent
agents.description: Builds management forecasts from approved finance sources.
agents.title: Autonomous AI agent enumerated directory profiles
agents.summary: A manual proxy story represents a service-to-service agent using tenant-wide read authority.
agents.recommendedActions: Confirm the application permission is justified and restrict the agent to isolated test resources.

agents.name: Contoso Legal Matter Agent
agents.description: Organizes approved legal matter files and correspondence.
agents.title: AI agent staged sensitive matter content
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models sensitive content staging by a legal workflow agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Inspect the agent's declared permissions and reduce access to matter-specific repositories.

agents.name: Contoso Sales Briefing Agent
agents.description: Prepares account briefings from approved customer records.
agents.title: AI agent queried an unrelated customer workspace
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models an agent crossing its expected customer-data boundary.
agents.recommendedActions: Review the agent card, sponsor, and delegated file access boundary.

agents.name: Contoso Mail Triage Agent
agents.description: Classifies messages and proposes mailbox triage actions.
agents.title: AI agent proposed suspicious mailbox changes
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models unexpected mailbox write behavior by a triage agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Review delegated mailbox authority and validate every proposed write operation.

agents.name: Contoso Calendar Coordinator Agent
agents.description: Coordinates internal meetings for consenting users.
agents.title: AI agent created an anomalous calendar invitation
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models suspicious invitation activity by a calendar agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Validate user consent and review the agent's calendar write boundary.

agents.name: Contoso Research Assistant Agent
agents.title: AI agent followed an untrusted research link
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models external retrieval from an untrusted source by a research agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Review allowed sources and apply outbound destination controls to the agent workflow.

agents.name: Contoso Operations Inventory Agent
agents.description: Reads approved directory profiles to prepare operations inventories.
agents.title: AI agent performed high-volume identity discovery
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models high-volume directory discovery by an autonomous inventory agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Confirm tenant-wide read access is essential and monitor the isolated test workload.

agents.name: Contoso Executive Briefing Agent
agents.description: Prepares executive summaries from approved internal sources.
agents.title: AI agent combined data across restricted contexts
agents.summary: A manual proxy story models cross-context data aggregation by an executive briefing agent.
agents.recommendedActions: Review data boundaries, delegated consent, and the agent's sponsor and owner assignments.
